title: Pocket Detection and Druggability Assessment
description: Identify binding pockets in a protein structure and score their druggability using fpocket geometry and property descriptors.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

pdb_input.description: PDB file or 4-letter PDB ID (e.g. '1IEP'). If a PDB ID is given, the structure is fetched from the RCSB.

min_druggability.description: Minimum druggability score (0–1) for a pocket to PASS the gate. 0.5 is considered tractable.
min_druggability.help_text: fpocket druggability score ≥ 0.5 correlates with experimentally druggable pockets (Schmidtke & Barril, 2010).

warn_druggability.description: Pockets scoring between warn_druggability and min_druggability receive a WARN status.

min_volume.description: Minimum pocket volume (Å³) to be considered a binding site. Most drug-binding pockets are 300–1500 Å³.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
